name: Lekki Conservation Centre
description: A protected nature reserve with marsh trails and a canopy walkway above the treetops. Visitors can spot monkeys, birds, and other wildlife.

name: Nike Art Gallery
address: 2 Elegushi Beach Road, Ikate, Lekki, Lagos
description: A multi-storey gallery filled with paintings, sculpture, and textiles by Nigerian artists.

name: Freedom Park
description: An arts and cultural site built on the grounds of a former colonial prison.

name: National Museum
description: Exhibits on Nigerian history, ethnography, and traditional art pieces.

name: Tarkwa Bay
description: A sheltered beach accessible only by boat, popular for water sports and swimming.

name: Lekki Crafts Market
address: Oba Yekini St, Lekki Peninsula II, Lagos
description: An open-air market for traditional crafts, wood carvings, and handmade jewelry.

name: Terra Kulture
address: 1376 Tiamiyu Savage St, Victoria Island, Lagos
description: An arts center featuring an art gallery, theater, restaurant, and language school.

name: Balogun Market
description: A sprawling, vibrant street market famous for textiles, fabrics, and clothing.
